result.title: The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science
result.summary: Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文主张对 agentic data science 的评估不应只看下游预测性能与代码正确性，进而在 220 个数据科学任务上大规模分析常见 agent 框架与模型的失败模式，构建可复用测试套件检验六类具体方法学失败，并与 Kaggle 优胜方案做定性对比，发现多数解至少含一种失败且数据泄漏与预测表现正相关。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「超出准确率」的评估立场与失败模式分类思路，可能为 LVR 评测中识别视觉旁路、答案未真正依赖视觉证据等「高分但方法错误」现象提供线索，可供核查其测试套件设计能否迁移到 latent 内容使用与贡献分配的诊断。
